Subject: Alignment: priority use-case + security gating for pilot (next 30 days)

Thanks for the discussion today — good to meet the Veridata team. I wanted to capture the key takeaways, confirm scope, and surface the immediate access/security gating items so we can kick the pilot off next week if you're aligned. TL;DR: 6-week pilot focused on your customer support reranking use case, target SLOs (95p latency < 200ms), and evaluation plan of ~500 prompt pairs.

Recap of pain points you shared
- Latency spikes on peak hours causing noticeable agent lag (current 95p ~= 450ms).
- Token costs make production rollout uncertain; need to validate per-request unit economics.
- Multi-tenant isolation + audit trail requirements for regulators (SOC2 + data residency in us-east).

Pilot goals / success metrics
- 95th percentile inference latency < 200ms for typical 512-token interaction (measured in your staging traffic pattern).
- End-to-end per-1M-token cost reduction by >= 25% versus current baseline.
- Maintain or improve reranking quality (measured via your NDCG on the 500-eval prompt set).

Scope (proposed)
- Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff, baseline & access, prompt suite runs, optimization, acceptance).
- Workloads: customer-support reranking pipelines + small chat assistant prototype.
- Eval set: 500 prompt/response pairs you will provide (we can help format).
- Models: Redwood-curated low-latency variants; fallback to 1-2 quantized options for cost analysis.

Immediate access & security gating (what we need from Veridata)
1) Service account + S3 read access for the eval bundle (s3://veridata-staging/pilot-eval).
2) VPC peering or IP allowlist for our staging endpoints (we can run through your infra team).
3) SOC2 questionnaire items — sending the stub separately; we can provide redacted logs for the pilot.
4) Point of contact for legal/Procurement to surface MSA/Docs required for environment provisioning.

Owners / next steps
- From Redwood: Ben (technical lead / pilot owner), Marissa (onsite ops & evals), Priyom (engagement manager).
- From Veridata: Daniel (product) + Elena (infra/security).

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): confirm scope, exchange access checklist, sign pilot SOW (minimal).
- Week 1: infra provisioning, eval data handoff, baseline runs.
- Weeks 2-4: iteration on batching/quantization/routing; run prompt eval sets.
- Week 5: quality & cost analysis; finalize recommendations.
- Week 6: acceptance review + decision on next steps (Dedicated or private deployment).

Attachments: I attached a short access checklist and a draft scope PDF (redwood_pilot_access_checklist.xlsx; redwood_poc_scope_draft.pdf).

Can you confirm: 1) that scope matches your expectations, 2) availability for a 30–45 minute kickoff on Thursday 11/5 or Friday 11/6, and 3) the security contact to complete VPC peering details?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Ben Carter
